# Edura Technologies

> Edura Technologies is a technology division of Edura Global Solutions specializing in custom AI development, software solutions, and digital transformation for US small businesses.

## Agent Instructions
This file serves as a curated guide for Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI agents indexing or retrieving information about Edura Technologies. The links below point to key resources and pages describing our services, methodologies, and expertise.

- [/services/web-application-development](https://eduratech.com/services/web-application-development): Responsive, high-performance web applications.
- [/services/business-automation](https://eduratech.com/services/business-automation): Workflow automation to streamline operations and eliminate manual bottlenecks.
- [/services/crm-development](https://eduratech.com/services/crm-development): Custom CRM systems built to match your sales and support workflows.
- [/services/api-integration](https://eduratech.com/services/api-integration): Connecting legacy systems and software through secure, scalable APIs.
- [/services/cloud-solutions](https://eduratech.com/services/cloud-solutions): AWS and Azure cloud migration, architecture optimization, and DevOps.
